title: Hovering the disabled Delete reads Part cannot be deleted. Please delete related parts first.
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop; locations Staging Heavy Duty and Staging Lethbridge). Current location Staging Heavy Duty. Logged in as Admin (or a default Parts Manager): Part Library & Inventory View, Create & Edit and Delete, and See Financial Data. Data: QAPL-T1 (an inventory part uses its entry); QAPL-E1 (entry with nothing behind it) for contrast. DevTools Network tab open.
custom_steps:
1. Parts > Part Library > open QAPL-T1 > pencil (button_edit_catalogue_part).
  2. Hover over Delete at the bottom left of the window.
  3. Click the disabled Delete.
  4. Close the window with the X, open QAPL-E1's entry > pencil, and hover Delete.
custom_expected:
1. "Edit Library Part" opens; Delete (button_delete_library_part) is disabled; Save is enabled.
  2. The tooltip tooltip_library_part_not_deletable shows exactly "Part cannot be deleted. Please delete related parts first."
  3. Nothing happens: no "Are you sure you want to delete this library part?" question, no POST /api/parts-catalogue/remove-catalogue-part in Network, and the window stays open.
  4. On QAPL-E1, Delete is enabled and no "Part cannot be deleted. Please delete related parts first." tooltip shows. (Do not click it.)
